name: Inverted row
equipment: low bar, rings or sturdy table
summary: Hanging under a low bar with heels on the floor and body straight, pull the chest to the bar.
setup: Lie under a bar at hip height, grip it, heels on the floor, body straight, side-on to the phone. Pull the chest to the bar with the elbows driving back, then lower under control.
brief: Lie under a bar, grip it, heels on the floor, body straight. Pull the chest to the bar with the elbows driving back, then lower under control.
why: From the side the elbow angle closes each rep, so reps are counted. The hips sagging is listed, not judged, because the bar often hides them.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Hips sagging
faults.tip: Squeeze the glutes so the body moves as one plank.

faults.label: Hips sagging
faults.tip: The body stays a plank. Sagging hips make the pull easier and load the back.

faults.label: Chest not reaching the bar
faults.tip: Touch the bar with the chest each rep, or raise the bar until you can.

faults.label: Not reaching the bar
faults.tip: Pull until the chest touches; if you cannot, raise the bar.

guide.surface: A bar that cannot roll or tip.
guide.cannotSee: The hips when the bar hides them.

points.t: Elbows drive back; chest reaches the bar.
